Method of Attack: Emails with subject 'Wanna see the Game of Thrones in advance?' containing malicious documents with embedded LNK files that run a Powershell script to install the 9002 remote access trojan
Phishing lure exploiting recent Game of Thrones episode leaks to entice targets to open malicious attachments
Impacted Systems: Infected machines running the 9002 remote access trojan
Attack Vector: Email phishing with malicious document attachments containing embedded LNK files
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject 'Wanna see the Game of Thrones in advance?'
